ns2:section.sectionText: This is a blended section: class meetings (2 hrs.) constitute part of the credit hour requirement, the rest is met by weekly online, web-based work (1 hr.).Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit. This course has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees.
